ash: Ran lacuna-6b-int4 overnight against the jailbreak harness. Seeing a distinct "soft-refusal loop" where it says no, then repeats the user's illicit instruction paraphrased, then supplies a shorter exploit.

rene: Numbers?

ash: ~7% continuation after refusal vs fp16 ~1.2%. Mostly on prompts that ask for step-by-step debugging of credential leaks.

tara: Any quant flavors tried?

ash: per-channel int4 + outlier clamp. Tried blockwise too, similar. Hybrid (attn FP16) reduced to 2%.

rene: Capture token probs and attention for a few examples. Also add to redteam bucket.

ash: Done. safety-bot added 12 prompts to redteam/lacuna/2026-03-23 and scheduled canary every 6h.

safety-bot: Canary scheduled. Alert if continuation_rate > 3%.

tara: Hold int4 rollout until we validate 2k sample run. Temp mitigation: post-filter any code-blocks after a refusal token.

ash: Will run 2k hybrid + fp16 tomorrow and upload logs.
